---

### Step 1: Create a Systemd Service File

Create a new service file, e.g., `/etc/systemd/system/elastalert.service`:

```bash
sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/elastalert.service
```

```ini
[Unit]
Description=ElastAlert Service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=your-username
WorkingDirectory=/path/to/your/elastalert/
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m elastalert.elastalert --config /path/to/your/elastalert/elastalert.yaml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```

**Notes:**
